about_the_game:
You are being swarmed!

Send the hostile waves of worms back into the void!

Deceptively simple physics-based core mechanics...

Combine the simplicity of homing auto-attacks with the impact of dash attacks, telekinetic blasts and wide pulling areas...

Emerging together into overwhelming combos with superpowers!

Each and every varied level reward superpower choice can combo with core mechanics, spiraling everything out of control... sometimes against you... The superpowers are all very intense and powerful and are meant to be felt through gameplay, without any stats or numbers

And unlockable mutations.

Alter how core mechanics behave, combine many mutations together after unlocking each one by winning...

Everything is a double-edged sword and a mystery to understand through extremely fast-paced action

Be prepared for the consequences and learn from them as you dodge frenzied enemies pinballing all over the map!

Feedback

The game is made from scratch without an engine, so feel free to report any graphics/sound/networking/performance issues to the Discord or Steam Forums!

Tips

  • You only get damaged if an enemy directly touches you

  • There is a small invulnerability window after dash and after being damaged

  • Keep smashing enemies into Walls for extra damage! But watch out for the bounce-back

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit fully updated or: 1909 revision .1350+, 2004 revision .789+, 20H2 revision .789+
  • Processor: Dual-Core Intel/AMD CPU
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX12 Shader Model 6.0 Waveops Resource Binding Tier 2+: Nvidia Kepler, AMD GCN1, Intel Gen9; an extremely strong CPU won't need a GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit fully updated
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel/AMD CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX12 Shader Model 6.8 Waveops Resource Binding Tier 3
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 48kHz stereo

short_description: Use physics and blast the worms back into the void! With deceptively simple core mechanics, the eldritch petri dish spirals out of control — either in your favor or against you — filled with arcane double-edged swords and extremely chaotic emergence via mutative superpower combos
